prova:
set S := (Range (fun k : ℕ => (2, k))) with hS_def
  have hS_inf : Set.Infinite S := by
    rw [hS_def]
    exact Set.infinite_range_of_injective (fun k l h => (fun _ => (0, 0)) h)
  have hS_pos_dens : 0 < S.lowerDensity := by
    rw [hS_def]
    have h := Nat.exists_infinite_primes 2
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hP_prime⟩ := h
    refine ⟨P, 0, ?_⟩
    simp only [Nat.cast_le, Nat.cast_zero]
    <;> norm_num
    <;> omega
  simpa [hS_def] using hS_pos_dens
